label: preparing
what: Probably a surprise gathering in the great hall to mark my forty years as mayor, presented to me as an eighteen hundred lighting/readiness check. The secretary coordinates the schedule, the builder and innkeeper arrange the hall and escort, and the neighbour may knowingly help by hosting tea beforehand. The hall preparations are explicit, but their celebratory purpose and the neighbour's knowing involvement remain inferences; I have no solid evidence implicating the baker, freight worker, or watchman.
